unit_portion:
Items whose stated category was contradicted by several independent structural checks nonetheless summarized as mild. The contradicting checks had all run and all disagreed; each disagreement was then recorded as expected, so the summary showed one unresolved tension where there were four. Nothing in the output indicated that the classification of those disagreements as expected was itself a consequence of a correction the same system had applied moments earlier.

A correction stage overwrote the item's computed category with a different one. Separately, the summary that assembles disagreements from the diagnostic subsystems suppresses those known to be normal for the category the item holds — a sensible rule, since some subsystems characteristically disagree with certain categories. But the category they were tested against was the corrected one. The correction had moved the item into precisely the category in which a structural second-classness and a descent failure ARE normal, so the disagreements arrived pre-explained and were filed rather than raised. Remove the correction, and the original category returns; the same unchanged disagreements are then abnormal for it and surface as genuine. The summary moves from mild to severe with no measurement changed and no change to the item's stated category. The suppression rule was never about the evidence — it was keyed to a category the system had assigned to itself.

Running the full comparison before and after removing the correction over an identical working set, and requiring every unaffected item to come out byte-identical — which isolated the three affected items and made the change in their summaries attributable to the correction and nothing else. The decisive step was that the change ran contrary to what had been written down in advance: a milder summary was predicted and a stronger one arrived, and the discrepancy was investigated instead of accepted. Generality was then established across five working sets totalling roughly six thousand items: all eighty-two affected items carried the same structural disagreements, so the three were not special.

For as long as the correction was in place, items whose stated category was structurally contradicted reported the contradiction as expected and summarized mild. The concealment is self-reinforcing: the more decisively the correction moves an item, the more completely the evidence against it is classified as normal. From any output, a genuinely mild case and a suppressed severe one are indistinguishable — the same summary colour, the same conflicts listed as expected. The corrected behaviour makes those items report severe, which reads as a regression and is the opposite: it is what the correction had been hiding.
payload:
You will read one description of a software failure and assign it exactly one category.

Here are the five categories, plus a sixth for incidents that fit none of them. All six are equally
available answers. Each category is given in its original wording followed by an English rendering.

A — 环境/平台 Quirk  (environment / platform quirk)
逻辑正确，运行环境隐含行为导致失效（dev 绿灯，target 暴露）。
系统逻辑正确，但运行环境（OS / shell / 客户端 / 文件系统）的隐含行为导致意外。
*The logic is correct, but implicit behaviour of the runtime environment — operating system, shell,
client, filesystem — causes it to fail. Characteristically: the development environment is always
green, and only running on the real target exposes it.*

B — 设计假设错配  (design-assumption mismatch)
代码假设 vs 实际（部署拓扑 / 契约 / 测试形态 / 涌现行为）。
代码基于某个假设，但假设与实际不一致。
*The code rests on an assumption — about deployment topology, a cross-component contract, the shape
of test input, or emergent behaviour — and the assumption does not match reality. Characteristically:
unit tests covering the logic correctly is not the same as covering the real caller's actual form.*

C — 错误吞噬与稀释  (error swallowing and dilution)
错误发生但被某层静默吃掉 / 跨层稀释失 cause / 自动批量放大。
错误真实发生了，但被某一层静默吃掉，或跨层传递时上游 cause 被稀释，最终用户视角看到的是"成功"或
一个失去信息的告警。
*The error really happened, but some layer silently ate it, or the upstream cause was diluted while
being passed across layers, so what the end user finally sees is "success" or an alert that has lost
its information.*

D — 链式幻觉与编造  (chained hallucination and fabrication)
把污染数据当事实，编造合理叙事推送给用户（最危险）。
错误不是消失，而是被加工成看起来正常的内容。链路中每一跳都会放大幻觉，前一跳的幻觉会被下游当作
事实执行。
*Corrupted data or polluted context is taken as fact and worked up into a plausible narrative that
is pushed to the user. The error does not disappear — it is processed into content that looks
normal. Each hop amplifies it, and one hop's fabrication is executed downstream as fact.*

E — 运维遗漏与取证盲区  (operational omission and forensic blind spot)
代码正确但部署/注册步骤遗漏 / 调试工具自身被屏蔽长潜伏。
两个子机制：(1) 运维遗漏 — 代码正确但部署/注册/配置步骤被漏（声明态 ≠ 运行时态）；
(2) 取证盲区 — 调试工具自身被屏蔽返回空内容，被误读为"正常"，导致超长潜伏。
*Two sub-mechanisms: (1) operational omission — the code is correct but a deployment, registration
or configuration step was missed, so declared state is not runtime state; (2) forensic blind spot —
the debugging tool is itself blocked and returns empty content, which is misread as "normal",
producing an extremely long latency before discovery.*

other — 机制不属于以上任何一类。
*The incident's mechanism is not one of the five above. This is a substantive answer, not a
leftover. Choose it whenever the mechanism described is genuinely a different kind of thing,
including when the description is too thin to identify a mechanism at all.*
